Manifest.Name: 上层区 Upper Levels：可能是DLC
Manifest.Author: Mr.K
Manifest.Description: 把店开进上层区：目前开放 2 个开局职业（上层区新店主、器官贩子，另外 6 个还在做）、第一幕剧情、43 种上层区新货、上层区客人与派系、赛博风格店铺装修。主菜单打开「上层区模式」即可开始；只想要装修可以在设置里单独打开。Open your shop in the Upper Levels: 2 playable professions for now (Upper Levels Newcomer and Organ Dealer, 6 more in the works), an opening story, 43 new goods, new clients and factions, and a cyberpunk shop. Turn on Upper Levels mode in the main menu; decor-only is in Settings.
